items.title: Nantes (SP) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 28 #1
items.en_title: Nantes (SP) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 28 #1
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Nantes (SP) is procuring professional or outsourced services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 87,000; proposals close Nov 28, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
